items.name: Yazoical
items.description: A social platform designed for software developers — focused on code sharing, technical blogging, and developer community building.
items.problem: Lack of a dedicated Turkish platform for developers to share technical knowledge.
items.solution: Markdown-powered code sharing, tagging system, and community features.

items.name: TEKNOFEST 2026 – Unmanned Ground Vehicle
items.description: Autonomous navigation system for the TEKNOFEST Unmanned Ground Vehicles competition.
items.problem: Obstacle detection and autonomous movement in complex terrain conditions.
items.solution: STM32-based control system, ESP32 WiFi module, and real-time image processing.

items.name: RoboCode Management System
items.description: Event, member, and project management platform for the Bitlis Eren University RoboCode club.
items.problem: Inefficiency from managing club operations via spreadsheets.
items.solution: Role-based access control, event calendar, and project tracking modules.
